page: Microsoft Azure D192s_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by a 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance provides 192 dedicated virtual CPUs across 96 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. System memory totals 768.0 GB RAM, adhering to a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB per vCPU. The processor features 260 MB of L3 cache and supports specialized instruction sets including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512. The instance contains zero GPUs and includes no local ephemeral storage, utilizing network-attached premium storage instead.

Benchmark results highlight exceptional parallel execution capabilities alongside standard single-thread throughput. In multi-core stress-ng tests and PassMark CPU metrics, the instance achieves top-tier scores, matching its 192-thread capacity. Application tests reflect this parallel efficiency, registering top-tier performance in Redis SET throughput at 173.14 million operations per second, static web serving at 188.19 GB per second, and PassMark database operations. Large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 510.75 GB per second. In contrast, single-core CPU metrics fall into the average tier, indicating that processing gains stem from thread scaling rather than raw per-thread clock advantages.

The D192s_v6 delivers strong resource density for enterprise workloads requiring massive thread concurrency. The absence of integrated local storage presents a minor operational tradeoff, requiring attached external volumes for persistent file access. This server profile is well matched for high-concurrency databases, distributed caching layers, large-scale web application serving, continuous integration build clusters, and parallel data compression pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure D192s_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz under Microsoft Hyper-V. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 192 dedicated vCPUs spanning 96 physical cores, supported by 768.0 GB of memory maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The processor integrates advanced vector instructions, AMX, and 260 MB of L3 cache. The instance features no bundled local storage and zero GPUs, operating strictly with remote storage attachments. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate top-tier multi-threaded compute, memory bandwidth, static web serving, and Redis throughput, balanced against median single-core speeds. With its extensive core density and memory pool, the D192s_v6 fits horizontally scaled web clusters, high-concurrency databases, in-memory caching nodes, and multi-threaded data processing workloads.
